text: Apple Inc.'s proxy statement for its 2026 annual meeting lists The Vanguard Group (9.63%) and BlackRock, Inc. (7.10%) as the holders known to beneficially own more than 5% of its common stock.
short: Apple Inc. is listed; largest holders Vanguard 9.63% and BlackRock 7.10% (2026 proxy).

source.name: Apple Inc. Definitive Proxy Statement (DEF 14A) for the 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders, security ownership of certain beneficial owners (SEC EDGAR)
